senses.gloss:
च्योत n. (-तं) Sprinkling, pouring forth, or dropping falling as an
unctuous substance, oozing, trickling, &c.
 E. च्युत् to wet or
moisten, affix घञ्.

च्योत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
 1. A mover, a goer, one who moves or goes.
 2.
Oviparous.
 3. Abandoned, wicked, void of virtue or purity.
 E. च्य
to go, Uṇādi affix त्रण्.
